tasks.short: Maintain press time and production records

steps.what: Capture job identity, work times, counts and explanations for production exceptions
Enter checked time and production figures in the production record
Reconcile recorded times and quantities and correct missing or inconsistent entries

tasks.design: Configure direct capture in {OPS_SYSTEM} to post the operator's checked entries without retyping them. Use the {OTHER} press controller's existing counters as references while retaining first capture and reconciliation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper figures can be re-entered into production records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can save captured data directly to the production register.
tasks.still_hard: Job attribution, downtime meaning and inconsistent counts.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining what happened on the press and resolving discrepancies.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry; first capture and record ownership remain.

reach.task: Use reconciled job records for planning

evidence.claim: Direct production-record capture and posting are E1 design assumptions; existing press counter runtime itself is not a new saving.
Dutch operator-linked production monitoring can require works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary is operator time and production records, excluding payroll, planner analysis and controller runtime.

Operator produces job identifier, date, start and end times, counter readings, accepted quantity, waste quantity and exception description in fully retained s1. The first capture moves to a form; unclear counts remain manual. S2 consumes those exact entries without a free reason code.
Native direct posting is tested first. If the current form already posts directly, the re-entry saving does not exist.
Four incremental operator hours per 100 baseline hours cover job mappings, field checks and failed posts; s3 retains all reconciliation.
unknowns: Actual re-entry baseline, press counters and current forms
research_questions: How much re-entry is eliminated after first capture and reconciliation are counted?

incremental.description: Mappings, form checks and failed posting handling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65; gross35 less4 upkeep gives31 net where duplicate posting exists. Already-direct records yield no gross gain and minus4 net; first capture and reconciliation retain65.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor printing supplies and request replenishment

steps.what: Check physical supply levels, material identity and usable condition
Record checked stock levels and compare available supplies with upcoming requirements
Assess shortages and prepare a checked request for additional printing supplies

tasks.design: Configure stock comparisons in {OPS_SYSTEM} and requisition defaults in {PROCUREMENT}. Retain physical checks, first observation capture and decisions on what to request; supplier ordering remains with purchasing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock observations and supply requests can repeat the same material details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock and requisition records can reuse checked values and calculate differences.
tasks.still_hard: Usable material condition, unusual jobs and uncertain requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when nominal stock will not meet the actual job.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison and request copying; physical stock checks remain.

evidence.claim: MultiPress includes stock and order-form functions, supporting native stock records without proving automatic replenishment.
Request preparation and task savings are E1 assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary covers operator monitoring and supply requests, excluding purchasing approval and supplier fulfilment.

Operator observes material, lot, location, usable quantity and unit in retained s1 and enters them in s2's ten remaining hours. Existing planner releases job quantities and stock requirements; no new upstream capture or free par-level input is assumed.
Operator chooses requested quantity, required date and shortage explanation in s3's nine remaining hours. Missing demand or uncertain stock is handled manually in s2 and s3.
Test native inventory and requisition defaults first. Three incremental hours per 100 baseline hours cover material mappings and form upkeep.
unknowns: Supply-record quality, planned requirements and current copying time
research_questions: Do stock comparisons and defaulted requests save time after capture and shortage decisions?

already_counted.description: Stock entry, requirement checks and exceptions

incremental.description: Material mappings and requisition form upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R84; gross16 less3 upkeep gives13 net. Sparse demand data may leave only3 hours gained and zero net; physical monitoring retains65.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor humidity and temperature and adjust for press performance

steps.what: Monitor humidity and temperature and assess their effect on materials and equipment performance
Make necessary approved adjustments and verify the effect on equipment performance

tasks.design: Keep environmental assessment and adjustments with the operator using approved limits in {DOCS}. No new sensors or automatic environmental control are assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effects depend on stock condition and the actual press response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instruments inform judgement without proving a reduction in monitoring or adjustment labour.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing environmental effects from material or mechanical faults.
tasks.human_edge: Interpreting combined conditions and verifying a safe correction.
tasks.altitude: No change to monitoring and adjustment time.

evidence.claim: Retaining environmental assessment and physical adjustments is an E1 judgement; the digest has no relevant control case.

assumptions: Boundary is direct monitoring, interpretation and adjustment, excluding facilities repair and separate reporting.
Worker reads existing instruments and checks material and press effects in retained s1; no structured adjustment recommendation or free cause code is assumed.
No new technology means zero upkeep. Existing instrument runtime is not saved labour.
unknowns: Available instruments and approved adjustment authority
research_questions: Which conditions require facilities intervention rather than operator adjustment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross0 and net0. Physical monitoring and correction remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Download digital print files or scan physical originals

steps.what: Identify the correct print-file version or physical original and its production destination
Download the selected digital file into the printing production software
Position physical originals and scan them using printing production software
Verify imported or scanned files for completeness, orientation and correct source version

tasks.design: Configure watched-folder transfer from {DOCS} into the {OTHER} printing production system for explicitly selected digital sources. Retain physical scanning and visual verification; file transfer does not release a print run.
tasks.previous_blocker: Digital files are manually downloaded into job folders while physical originals still need scanning.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing print-flow tools can transfer selected files and preserve job references.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong revisions, missing pages and physical scan quality.
tasks.human_edge: Verifying the intended original and visible output.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive digital downloading; scanning and file verification remain.

evidence.claim: Enfocus Switch automates print job flow, supporting configured file transfer; the digest's combined prepress case is not a direct downloading-time estimate.
The digital-versus-physical mix and task saving are E1 scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is source selection, digital downloading or physical scanning, and import verification, excluding preflight, editing and press release.
S2 and s3 are alternative source branches; their shares represent aggregate time across digital and physical jobs, not both operations for every file.

Operator produces job identifier, exact file revision or source path, destination and selection approval in fully retained s1. Digital file identity is bound to the selected snapshot; a changed file requires reselection. Missing sources are retrieved manually in s1.

S2 consumes that checked contract and does not choose or print files. Physical scanning and visual checks remain fully retained. Native flow configuration is tested first; three incremental operator hours per 100 baseline hours cover transfer rules and failed-file handling.
unknowns: Digital-versus-scanned job mix, source versioning and current transfer support
research_questions: Do selected-file transfers save time after source selection, failures and visual checks?

already_counted.description: Source identification, capture and exact transfer approval
Visual verification of transferred or scanned output

approvals.approved_version: Exact job, source snapshot, file revision and destination approved in s1; any source or destination change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70; gross30 less3 upkeep gives27 net for the stated mixed workload. Predominantly physical originals or existing automatic transfer may yield no new gain and minus3 net; scanning and checks do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate records and selected digital transfers while retaining physical stock and environmental checks.
role.ambitious_version: Capture operational facts once and transfer only selected files, without reducing physical checks or operator accountability.
